vocabulary.DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE: contaminated A/B on a busy machine. Guides. Never promotes.
vocabulary.PROTECTED_ABSOLUTE: measurement taken under a real protected GPU lease. Decides.
vocabulary.STATIC_ONLY: this sidecar. No GPU. Bench state UNKNOWN. Cannot promote.
